title: 第23章 捡了个少年第24章 哈哈你们的蛋碎了
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
另一边，云星落已经跑出去老远。
夜幕降临，黑雾森林里的雾气也越来越浓。
她不敢耽误，加快了脚步，直往寻仙镇的方向奔去！
可就在距离镇子只剩四五公里的时候，头顶上突然传来咻咻的破空声，还夹杂着锵锵的打斗声，震得树叶直簌簌往下掉。
云星落心里一紧，立马敛了气息藏到一棵大树上。
声音越来越近，她扒开叶子偷偷往上看。
只见虚空中三个身着黑袍的中年人，正在追击一名身着黑色劲装的少年。
少年似乎受伤不轻，御空时身形有些踉跄。
少年身后，凌冽的破空声响起，三柄泛着幽蓝寒光的尖刀已逼至咫尺，刀风里还裹着淡淡的魔气。
“太子殿下，不要再负隅顽抗了，魔君有令，只要你愿意献出你的魔核和魔骨，魔君便不再为难王妃。”
另两人没有说话，却是同时抬手结印，两条漆黑的锁链遽然甩出，直往夜璟的脚踝缠绕过来。
少年猛地旋身避开，腰间的佩剑蹭地出鞘，剑光如闪电般划破长空，斩向那两条漆黑的铁链。
“锵”
的一声，铁链被恐怖的剑气震飞。
但是三天三夜的逃亡，他灵力已经耗尽，就连他的魔核也已经燃烧消耗殆尽，这是他能发出的最后一击了。
他一手捂住胸口，那里有母妃离开前塞给他的护心玉。
护心玉温暖着他的胸口，但却挡不住刺骨的寒意。
母妃死了，那个男人为了扶小三上位，把母妃的金丹挖了出来，熬成丹药喂给小三吃。
母亲的残躯被扔下万蛇谷，至今下落不明。
就这样他们还不放过他，还要把他的魔核也拿出来给小三的儿子吃。

少年捂住胸口，一声心碎的呐喊，“我好恨！”
后面，三名黑袍人见状心头狂喜，“他撑不住了，快，撒捆仙网。”
然而就在三人祭出捆仙网之际，少年猛然坠入黑雾森林中。
大树上，云星落正伸长脖子观看着虚空中的战斗，突然一个黑影砸到了树上，接连砸断几根树枝才停下来。
黑影挂在树枝上，正挂在她的面前。
她还没来得及躲，少年突然伸手抓住她的手腕，声音虚弱，“救我……”
“卧槽！”
云星落下意识蹦出前世的国粹，整个人都懵了。
这时，她怀里的圣图突然闪了闪，图图的声音急得快要劈叉，“快！
把他拍晕拖进圣图里！
不然那三个黑袍人下来，你俩都得死！”
云星落哪敢耽误，抬手就往少年脖子上拍了一掌。
content_en:
On the other side, Yun Xingluo had already run far away.
As night falls, the fog in the black forest becomes thicker and thicker.
She didn't dare to delay, so she quickened her pace and ran straight towards Xunxian Town!
But when there were only four or five kilometers left from the town, there was a sudden whistling sound in the air overhead, mixed with the sound of a loud fight, which made the leaves rustle and fall.
Yun Xingluo's heart tightened, and she immediately gathered her breath and hid in a big tree.
The sound was getting closer and closer, so she opened the leaves and looked up secretly.
I saw three middle-aged men in black robes chasing a young man in black attire in the void.
The young man seemed to be seriously injured and staggered a little while flying in the air.
Behind the young man, a sharp sound broke through the air. Three sharp knives with a cold blue light were close at hand, and the wind of the swords was still wrapped in a faint devilish aura.
"Your Highness, please stop resisting. The Demon Lord has an order. As long as you are willing to sacrifice your demon core and bones, the Demon Lord will no longer embarrass the princess."
The other two people didn't speak, but they raised their hands to form seals at the same time. Two dark chains suddenly flew out and wrapped around Ye Jing's ankles.
The young man suddenly turned around to avoid it, and the sword at his waist was unsheathed. The light of the sword cut through the sky like lightning, slashing at the two dark iron chains.
"Qiang"
With a sound, the iron chain was blown away by the terrifying sword energy.
But after three days and three nights of escaping, his spiritual power had been exhausted, and even his magic core had been burned and consumed. This was the last blow he could deliver.
He covered his chest with one hand, where there was the heart-protecting jade that his mother-in-law had given him before she left.
The heart-protecting jade warmed his chest, but it couldn't stop the biting chill.
The mother-in-law died. In order to help the mistress to ascend to the throne, the man dug out the mother-in-law's golden elixir, boiled it into elixir and fed it to the mistress.
The mother's body was thrown into the Valley of Ten Thousand Snakes and her whereabouts are still unknown.
Even so, they still didn't let him go, and even took out his magic core to feed Xiaosan's son.
The young man covered his chest and shouted heartbreakingly, "I hate it so much!"
Behind him, the three men in black robes were ecstatic when they saw this, "He can't hold on any longer, hurry up and cast the fairy net."
However, just as the three of them were holding out the Immortal Binding Net, the young man suddenly fell into the black mist forest.
On the big tree, Yun Xingluo was stretching his neck to watch the battle in the void. Suddenly, a black shadow hit the tree, breaking several branches before stopping.
A dark shadow hung on the branch, right in front of her.
Before she could hide, the boy suddenly reached out and grabbed her wrist, with a weak voice, "Help me..."
"Fuck!"
Yun Xingluo's consciousness came up with the national quintessence of his previous life, and he was completely confused.
At this time, the holy picture in her arms suddenly flashed, and Tutu's voice was so anxious that she almost split her head, "Quick!"
Knock him out and drag him into the holy picture!
Otherwise, when those three men in black robes come down, you will both die! "
Yun Xingluo didn't dare to delay. He raised his hand and slapped the young man on the neck.
